mapper.select: SELECT e.maker_id AS id, e.user_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM maker e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'MAKER' AND t.target_id = e.maker_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.maker_id

mapper.update: UPDATE maker SET name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND maker_id = #{makerId}
